mapper.select: SELECT id, config_id, window_started_at, window_requests, consecutive_failures, open_until, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_provider_call_gate WHERE config_id = #{configId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manga_model_call_ledger WHERE config_id = #{configId} AND status = 'STARTED' AND expires_at > #{now}
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(reserved_usd), 0) FROM manga_model_call_ledger WHERE config_id = #{configId} AND started_at >= #{start}
mapper.update: UPDATE manga_model_call_ledger SET status = #{call.status}, usage_reported = #{call.usageReported}, input_tokens = #{call.inputTokens}, output_tokens = #{call.outputTokens}, cached_tokens = #{call.cachedTokens}, reasoning_tokens = #{call.reasoningTokens}, cache_creation_tokens = #{call.cacheCreationTokens}, tool_use_prompt_tokens = #{call.toolUsePromptTokens}, calculated_usd = #{call.calculatedUsd}, failure_type = #{call.failureType}, finished_at = #{call.finishedAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE call_id = #{call.callId} AND status = 'STARTED'
mapper.select: SELECT id, call_id, run_id, step_id, owner_epoch, config_id, model_name, blueprint_fingerprint, status, usage_reported, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, reasoning_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, tool_use_prompt_tokens, input_price, cached_input_price, output_price, reserved_usd, calculated_usd, settled_usd, settled_by, settled_at, settlement_note, failure_type, started_at, expires_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_model_call_ledger WHERE call_id = #{callId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT id, call_id, run_id, step_id, owner_epoch, config_id, model_name, blueprint_fingerprint, status, usage_reported, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, reasoning_tokens, cache_creation_tokens, tool_use_prompt_tokens, input_price, cached_input_price, output_price, reserved_usd, calculated_usd, settled_usd, settled_by, settled_at, settlement_note, failure_type, started_at, expires_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_model_call_ledger WHERE status = 'STARTED' AND expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id LIMIT 100

SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(input_tokens) AS input_tokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS output_tokens, SUM(calculated_usd) AS calculated_usd, SUM(settled_usd) AS settled_usd, SUM(CASE WHEN calculated_usd IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unpriced_or_unknown_calls, SUM(CASE WHEN status != 'SUCCEEDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS possibly_partial_calls FROM manga_model_call_ledger WHERE started_at >= #{since} GROUP BY status
SELECT id, config_id, window_started_at, window_requests, consecutive_failures, open_until, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_provider_call_gate ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 100
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS runs, MIN(created_at) AS oldest_created_at FROM manga_creative_run GROUP BY status

SELECT r.run_id FROM manga_creative_run r LEFT JOIN manga_creative_run_archive a ON a.run_id = r.run_id WHERE r.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'FAILED', 'CANCELLED') AND r.finished_at < #{before} AND a.id IS NULL ORDER BY r.id LIMIT 10
SELECT id, run_id, schema_version, payload_json, sha256, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM manga_creative_run_archive WHERE run_id = #{runId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manga_creative_run_archive(run_id, schema_version, payload_json, sha256, created_by, updated_by) VALUES(#{runId}, #{schemaVersion}, #{payloadJson}, #{sha256}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT step_id, parent_step_id, step_type, status, blueprint_snapshot_json, input_json, result_json, output_json, owner_epoch, state_session_id, delegation_plan_id, node_key FROM manga_creative_step WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT sequence_no, event_type, step_id, payload_json, schema_version, source, correlation_id, created_at FROM manga_creative_event WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY sequence_no LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, conversation_id, run_id, role, status, content, projection_key, tool_call_id, tool_name, tool_status, first_sequence, last_sequence, created_at FROM manga_creative_message WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT plan_id, parent_step_id, frozen_json, status, round_no FROM manga_creative_delegation WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT change_set_id, step_id, status, kind, schema_version, base_project_revision, base_chapter_revision, before_json, payload_json, result_json FROM manga_creative_change_set WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM manga_generation_job WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED')

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(blueprint_snapshot_json, '')) + CHAR_LENGTH(input_json) + CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(output_json, '')) + CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(result_json, ''))), 0) FROM manga_creative_step WHERE run_id = #{runId}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(payload_json)), 0) FROM manga_creative_event WHERE run_id = #{runId}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(content)), 0) FROM manga_creative_message WHERE run_id = #{runId}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(frozen_json)), 0) FROM manga_creative_delegation WHERE run_id = #{runId}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(before_json) + CHAR_LENGTH(payload_json) + CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(result_json, ''))), 0) FROM manga_creative_change_set WHERE run_id = #{runId}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CHAR_LENGTH(COALESCE(a.comment, ''))), 0) FROM manga_creative_approval a JOIN manga_creative_change_set c ON c.change_set_id = a.change_set_id WHERE c.run_id = #{runId})
